$schema_note: Framework-agnostic design tokens. See design/README.md for the aesthetic thesis these were pulled from.

turmeric_yellow.source: Munna Tea Stall signboard (सफ़र-ए-UP reference); "Songs that play..." subtext color (हॉर्न ओके प्लीज़ reference)

tamarind_brown.source: Sepia/ochre background wash and wood tones across the सफ़र-ए-UP reference

chilli_red.source: Gopal Ghee Bhandar signboard (सफ़र-ए-UP reference); डीलक्स सैलून building facade

mint_green.source: Muted tree foliage in the सफ़र-ए-UP reference

saffron_orange.source: Dusk sky and ghee-shop orange (हॉर्न ओके प्लीज़ / सफ़र-ए-UP references)

deep_indigo.source: Night highway sky (हॉर्न ओके प्लीज़ reference)

dhaba_cream.source: UP state transport bus body and signboard backgrounds (सफ़र-ए-UP reference)

coal_black.source: Dark UI chrome and lettering outlines across all three references

signboard_white.source: Hero headline color in all three references ("अगली बस आ गई है।", "हॉर्न ओके प्लीज़", "डीलक्स सैलून")

dusk_purple.source: Twilight sky gradient behind the truck (हॉर्न ओके प्लीज़ reference)

kadhai_black.source: Deepest shadow tone, darker than coal_black -- for drop shadows and pressed states

chilli_red_soft.source: Not from a reference image -- a synthesized 60% tint of chilli_red toward signboard_white, added in Part F specifically because chilli_red itself fails WCAG AA (2.29:1) as text color against the dark-mode background (design/contrast-report.md). Only used as accent_warning_text's dark-mode value, never as a general-purpose swatch.

surface_signboard.purpose: Colored card/panel backgrounds that mimic a painted shop sign

ink_body.purpose: Default body text on light surfaces

ink_hero.purpose: Hero headline text, set over painterly/illustrated backgrounds

accent_action.purpose: Primary buttons and calls to action

accent_success.purpose: Not in the Phase 3 brief's required list -- added because adherence/streak UI needs an "on track" color distinct from celebration/warning.

surface_card.purpose: Raised light surface for list items and form inputs (ThaliCard, text inputs, the bottom nav bar) -- distinct from surface_primary (the page background behind it) and from surface_signboard (a colored painted-sign panel). Added Part E: this needed its own token once it also had to swap in dark mode.

accent_action_text.purpose: Part F contrast fix: accent_action's actual hex (saffron_orange) is only ~2.4:1 against light surfaces as small text/link color -- nowhere near the 4.5:1 WCAG AA floor (design/contrast-report.md). Use this instead whenever the action color is the text itself (links, the qty +/- buttons, the active bottom-nav label) and reserve raw accent_action for backgrounds/icons/borders, where its own contrast against light surfaces is fine.

accent_warning_text.purpose: Part F contrast fix: chilli_red itself is fine as warning TEXT in light mode (4.70:1) -- unchanged here. Kept as a separate token from accent_warning (rather than reusing it directly) only because the dark-mode value has to diverge; see semantic_dark.

semantic_dark.$note: Phase 4 Part E. Dark mode is 'the same night market, seen at dusk' -- warm signboard colors stay warm, only the ambient background and body ink shift. accent_* tokens are deliberately reused unchanged from the light palette (they're already saturated enough to read on a dark ground); design/contrast-report.md (Part F) is the formal WCAG AA check and the place any pair gets retuned if it fails, rather than guessing adjustments here.

surface_primary.purpose: Default app background in dark mode -- deep indigo (the हॉर्न ओके प्लीज़ night-highway sky), not a flat #111/#222 tech-dark.

surface_signboard.purpose: Unchanged from light mode -- a painted wooden signboard doesn't change color at night, only what's around it does.

ink_body.purpose: Default body text in dark mode -- warm cream, not pure white, echoing the bus-body/signboard cream from the light palette's ink_hero family.

ink_hero.purpose: Unchanged -- still set over already-colored signboard surfaces, not directly on the dark background.

surface_card.purpose: Raised surface in dark mode -- lighter than surface_primary's deep_indigo (a card should read as sitting above the background), still in the same twilight-purple family rather than introducing a new hue.

accent_action_text.purpose: Part F contrast fix, dark-mode side: tamarind_brown (the light-mode fix) is too dark against deep_indigo/dusk_purple to read at all. turmeric_yellow keeps the same 'this is the warm accent, and it's tappable' read while actually passing 4.5:1 against both dark surfaces.

accent_warning_text.purpose: Part F contrast fix: chilli_red itself is only 2.29:1 against deep_indigo -- chilli_red_soft (a lightened tint, see its palette entry) passes comfortably against both surface_primary and surface_card in dark mode.
